text:
ECA::status
Description
The ECA::status command returns NTLM authentication result such as
NTLM_STATUS_OK, NTLM_STATUS_WRONG_PASSWORD, NTLM_STATUS_NO_SUCH_USER.
Syntax
ECA
::
status
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
path
]
starts_with
"/protected_uri"
}
{
ECA
::
enable
ECA
::
select
select_ntlm:
/
Common
/
exch_ntlm_auth_config
}
else
{
ECA
::
disable
}
log
local0.
"User [ECA::username]@[ECA::domainname], Client Machine [ECA::client_machine_name], Auth Status [ECA::status]"
}
